paragraphs: In Kiddushin 40b: Rabbi Tarfon and the elders were once reclining in the upper chamber of Beit Natzeh in Lod; Rabbi Tarfon spoke up—Rabbi Akiva spoke up, etc.[^1]

notes.text: William Davidson Kiddushin 40b fully writes Rabbi Tarfon and Rabbi Akiva in the upper chamber of Beit Natzeh in Lod. These names support the local expansions of ר״ט and ר״ע. Hyman’s dash and ‘etc.’ remain; the intervening arguments are not added.
